name: smart-lost-and-found
description: Smart Lost & Found – College Campus Lost & Found Management System (React + Node.js/Express + MongoDB)
author: madhusudhan1260

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm run seed --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix backend
